chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which he mentions the Household of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the Household of Muhammad in his sermons?
ai.summary: This introductory clause from Nahj al-Balagha sets the stage for Imam Ali’s exposition on the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing their unique spiritual authority and proximity to the Prophet. In Shia scholarship, this context underscores the concept of *Wilayah* (divine guardianship) and the infallibility (*Ismah*) of the Prophet's household as the rightful successors and interpreters of the Quran.
